payload.text:
Prove this Lean 4 theorem (source: LeanCat, difficulty: medium).

Informal statement:
Let G and H be groups. If their binary coproduct exists in the category of groups, then the free product of G and H is isomorphic to that categorical coproduct.

Formal statement to prove:
theorem freeProdGrp_iso_coprod [HasBinaryCoproduct G H] :
    Nonempty (GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod G H) ≅ coprod G H)

The theorem is stated in this context (already in scope; do not restate it, and keep these when you write the proof):
open CategoryTheory Limits
universe u
variable {G H : GrpCat.{u}}

Use the typed subgoal tools to decompose, verify, review, and route. For this medium task, define four to six concrete compile-verifiable artifacts; do not use vague understand/find/investigate subgoals. Build at least two work subgoals plus one final integration subgoal; use sequential dependencies when the mathematics is sequential. Do not use HANDOFF or VERDICT text markers. Use search_lemmas and compiler tools when they resolve real uncertainty. Hand off only when the receiving role can act on concrete mathematical, compiler, or review evidence. A non-linear route is allowed, but extra communication is not itself success. The final proof must compile, preserve the exact statement, and contain no sorry, admit, or added axiom.

-- Define the lift morphism
def lift_morphism : GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod ↑G ↑H) ⟶ W := 
  GrpCat.ofHom (Monoid.Coprod.lift (GrpCat.Hom.hom' f) (GrpCat.Hom.hom' g))

lemma lift_comp_inl : lift_morphism.comp inl_morphism = f := by

{"code":"theorem freeProdGrp_iso_coprod [HasBinaryCoproduct G H] :
    Nonempty (GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod G H) ≅ coprod G H) := by
  -- Define the inclusion morphisms
  let inl_morphism : G ⟶ GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod ↑G ↑H) :=
    GrpCat.ofHom (Monoid.Coprod.inl : ↑G →* Monoid.Coprod ↑G ↑H)
  let inr_morphism : H ⟶ GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod ↑G ↑H) :=
    GrpCat.ofHom (Monoid.Coprod.inr : ↑H →* Monoid.Coprod ↑G ↑H)
  
  -- Construct morphism from coprod G H to GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod ↑G ↑H)
  let to_free_prod : coprod G H ⟶ GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod ↑G ↑H) :=
    coprod.desc inl_morphism inr_morphism
  
  -- Construct morphism from GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod ↑G ↑H) to coprod G H
  let from_free_prod : GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod ↑G ↑H) ⟶ coprod G H :=
    GrpCat.ofHom (Monoid.Coprod.lift (GrpCat.Hom.hom' (coprod.inl : G ⟶ coprod G H)) (GrpCat.Hom.hom' (coprod.inr : H ⟶ coprod G H)))
  
  -- Show that from_free_prod ∘ to_free_prod = id
  have h1 : from_free_prod ∘ to_free_prod = 1 := by
    -- Use the universal property of coprod
    apply IsColimit.hom_ext
    simp [to_free_prod, from_free_prod, coprod.desc, GrpCat.ofHom, Monoid.Coprod.lift_comp_inl, Monoid.Coprod.lift_comp_inr]
  
  -- Show that to_free_prod ∘ from_free_prod = id
  have h2 : to_free_prod ∘ from_free_prod = 1 := by
    -- Use the universal property of Monoid.Coprod
    ext x
    simp [to_free_prod, from_free_prod, coprod.desc, GrpCat.ofHom, Monoid.Coprod.lift]
  
  -- Construct the isomorphism
  let iso : GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod G H) ≅ coprod G H :=
    { hom := from_free_prod, inv := to_free_prod, hom_inv_id := h2, inv_hom_id := h1 }
  
  exact ⟨iso⟩","subgoal_id":"sg3","purpose":"subgoal"}

    Nonempty (GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod G H) ≅ coprod G H) := by
  -- Define the inclusion morphisms
  let inl_morphism : G ⟶ GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod ↑G ↑H) :=
    GrpCat.ofHom (Monoid.Coprod.inl : ↑G →* Monoid.Coprod ↑G ↑H)
  let inr_morphism : H ⟶ GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod ↑G ↑H) :=
    GrpCat.ofHom (Monoid.Coprod.inr : ↑H →* Monoid.Coprod ↑G ↑H)
  
  -- Construct morphism from coprod G H to GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod ↑G ↑H)
  let to_free_prod : coprod G H ⟶ GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod ↑G ↑H) :=
    coprod.desc inl_morphism inr_morphism
  
  -- Construct morphism from GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod ↑G ↑H) to coprod G H
  let from_free_prod : GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod ↑G ↑H) ⟶ coprod G H :=
    GrpCat.ofHom (Monoid.Coprod.lift (GrpCat.Hom.hom' (coprod.inl : G ⟶ coprod G H)) (GrpCat.Hom.hom' (coprod.inr : H ⟶ coprod G H)))
  
  -- Show that from_free_prod ∘ to_free_prod = id
  have h1 : from_free_prod ≫ to_free_prod = 1 := by
    -- Use the universal property of coprod
    apply IsColimit.hom_ext
    simp [to_free_prod, from_free_prod, coprod.desc, GrpCat.ofHom, Monoid.Coprod.lift_comp_inl, Monoid.Coprod.lift_comp_inr]
  
  -- Show that to_free_prod ∘ from_free_prod = id
  have h2 : to_free_prod ≫ from_free_prod = 1 := by
    -- Use the universal property of Monoid.Coprod
    ext x
    simp [to_free_prod, from_free_prod, coprod.desc, GrpCat.ofHom, Monoid.Coprod.lift]
  
  -- Construct the isomorphism
  let iso : GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod G H) ≅ coprod G H :=
    { hom := from_free_prod, inv := to_free_prod, hom_inv_id := h2, inv_hom_id := h1 }
  
  exact ⟨iso⟩","subgoal_id":"sg3","purpose":"subgoal"}

{"code":"theorem freeProdGrp_iso_coprod [HasBinaryCoproduct G H] :
    Nonempty (GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod G H) ≅ coprod G H) := by
  -- Define the inclusion morphisms
  let inl_morphism : G ⟶ GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod ↑G ↑H) :=
    GrpCat.ofHom (Monoid.Coprod.inl : ↑G →* Monoid.Coprod ↑G ↑H)
  let inr_morphism : H ⟶ GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod ↑G ↑H) :=
    GrpCat.ofHom (Monoid.Coprod.inr : ↑H →* Monoid.Coprod ↑G ↑H)
  
  -- Show that GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod ↑G ↑H) with these inclusions is a coproduct
  have is_coproduct : IsColimit (BinaryCofan.mk inl_morphism inr_morphism) := by
    -- Use the universal property of Monoid.Coprod
    constructor
    · -- Show that for any W and morphisms f, g, there exists a unique morphism
      intro W f g
      use GrpCat.ofHom (Monoid.Coprod.lift (GrpCat.Hom.hom' f) (GrpCat.Hom.hom' g))
      constructor
      · -- Show that the morphism makes the diagram commute
        constructor
        · -- inl_morphism ≫ lift = f
          ext x
          simp [GrpCat.ofHom, Monoid.Coprod.lift_comp_inl]
        · -- inr_morphism ≫ lift = g
          ext x
          simp [GrpCat.ofHom, Monoid.Coprod.lift_comp_inr]
      · -- Show uniqueness
        intro h hh
        ext x
        simp [GrpCat.ofHom, hh] at *
        -- Use the uniqueness of Monoid.Coprod.lift
        exact Monoid.Coprod.lift_unique hh.1 hh.2
  
  -- Use the fact that coproducts are unique up to isomorphism
  have iso : GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod G H) ≅ coprod G H := by
    -- Use the comparison morphism between two coproducts
    apply IsColimit.iso
    · exact is_coproduct
    · exact coprodIsCoprod G H
  
  exact ⟨iso⟩","subgoal_id":"sg3","purpose":"subgoal"}

{"code":"theorem freeProdGrp_iso_coprod [HasBinaryCoproduct G H] :
    Nonempty (GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod G H) ≅ coprod G H) := by
  -- Use the fact that GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod G H) satisfies the universal property
  -- of the coproduct, and coprod G H is the categorical coproduct.
  -- Therefore, they are isomorphic.
  
  -- Define the inclusion morphisms
  let inl_morphism : G ⟶ GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod ↑G ↑H) :=
    GrpCat.ofHom (Monoid.Coprod.inl : ↑G →* Monoid.Coprod ↑G ↑H)
  let inr_morphism : H ⟶ GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod ↑G ↑H) :=
    GrpCat.ofHom (Monoid.Coprod.inr : ↑H →* Monoid.Coprod ↑G ↑H)
  
  -- Construct morphism from coprod G H to GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod ↑G ↑H)
  let to_free_prod : coprod G H ⟶ GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod ↑G ↑H) :=
    coprod.desc inl_morphism inr_morphism
  
  -- Construct morphism from GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod ↑G ↑H) to coprod G H
  let from_free_prod : GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod ↑G ↑H) ⟶ coprod G H :=
    GrpCat.ofHom (Monoid.Coprod.lift (GrpCat.Hom.hom' (coprod.inl : G ⟶ coprod G H)) (GrpCat.Hom.hom' (coprod.inr : H ⟶ coprod G H)))
  
  -- Show that from_free_prod ∘ to_free_prod = id
  have h1 : from_free_prod ≫ to_free_prod = 1 := by
    apply IsColimit.hom_ext
    · simp [to_free_prod, from_free_prod, coprod.desc, GrpCat.ofHom, Monoid.Coprod.lift_comp_inl]
    · simp [to_free_prod, from_free_prod, coprod.desc, GrpCat.ofHom, Monoid.Coprod.lift_comp_inr]
  
  -- Show that to_free_prod ∘ from_free_prod = id
  have h2 : to_free_prod ≫ from_free_prod = 1 := by
    ext x
    simp [to_free_prod, from_free_prod, coprod.desc, GrpCat.ofHom, Monoid.Coprod.lift]
  
  -- Construct the isomorphism
  let iso : GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod G H) ≅ coprod G H :=
    { hom := from_free_prod, inv := to_free_prod, hom_inv_id := h2, inv_hom_id := h1 }
  
  exact ⟨iso⟩","subgoal_id":"sg3","purpose":"subgoal"}

{"code":"theorem freeProdGrp_iso_coprod [HasBinaryCoproduct G H] :
    Nonempty (GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod G H) ≅ coprod G H) := by
  -- Define the inclusion morphisms
  let inl_morphism : G ⟶ GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod ↑G ↑H) :=
    GrpCat.ofHom (Monoid.Coprod.inl : ↑G →* Monoid.Coprod ↑G ↑H)
  let inr_morphism : H ⟶ GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod ↑G ↑H) :=
    GrpCat.ofHom (Monoid.Coprod.inr : ↑H →* Monoid.Coprod ↑G ↑H)
  
  -- Construct morphism from coprod G H to GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod ↑G ↑H)
  let to_free_prod : coprod G H ⟶ GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod ↑G ↑H) :=
    coprod.desc inl_morphism inr_morphism
  
  -- Construct morphism from GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod ↑G ↑H) to coprod G H
  let from_free_prod : GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod ↑G ↑H) ⟶ coprod G H :=
    GrpCat.ofHom (Monoid.Coprod.lift (GrpCat.Hom.hom' (coprod.inl : G ⟶ coprod G H)) (GrpCat.Hom.hom' (coprod.inr : H ⟶ coprod G H)))
  
  -- Show that from_free_prod ∘ to_free_prod = id
  have h1 : from_free_prod ≫ to_free_prod = 1 := by
    apply IsColimit.hom_ext
    · simp [to_free_prod, from_free_prod, coprod.desc, GrpCat.ofHom, Monoid.Coprod.lift_comp_inl]
    · simp [to_free_prod, from_free_prod, coprod.desc, GrpCat.ofHom, Monoid.Coprod.lift_comp_inr]
  
  -- Show that to_free_prod ∘ from_free_prod = id
  have h2 : to_free_prod ≫ from_free_prod = 1 := by
    ext x
    simp [to_free_prod, from_free_prod, coprod.desc, GrpCat.ofHom, Monoid.Coprod.lift]
  
  -- Construct the isomorphism
  let iso : GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod G H) ≅ coprod G H :=
    { hom := from_free_prod, inv := to_free_prod, hom_inv_id := h2, inv_hom_id := h1 }
  
  exact ⟨iso⟩","subgoal_id":"sg3","purpose":"subgoal"}
